recalled_source.name: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation post-2010 recall flat file
recalled_source.selection: Rows with a 2010–2026 model year, non-empty manufacturer/model/campaign, numeric RECORD_ID and YYYYMMDD RCDATE; deterministic SHA-256 ordering by RECORD_ID; duplicate normalized make/model/year keys skipped; first 500 unique inventory items. No checker output used for inclusion or labels.
recalled_source.license_terms: NHTSA sources.json identifies the feed as U.S. government public data. Source content is U.S. government data; API endpoints are public. Attribution and source links retained in every recalled row.

synthetic_clean_source.method: Fictitious reserved brand/model values generated solely as synthetic inventory negatives. No real brand, model, or product is represented; expected no_match assigned by construction before checker evaluation.
synthetic_clean_source.license_terms: Original synthetic labels and rows; no third-party content.

scope_limit: This set tests NHTSA vehicle make/model/year matching plus synthetic no-match handling. It does not establish accuracy for CPSC, FDA, FSIS, barcodes, individual VINs, or real-world clean products.
borderline_second_engine_check: Separate matcher route review remains outside this data-only card and is tracked by claim claim-ph12-12-recall-benchmark-engine; no borderline-route result is claimed here.
